mechanism.summary: Execute a bytecode-proven, self-recursive primitive-number call cluster with reusable scalar frames, retaining the ordinary direct-leaf VM for every unsupported instruction, value, capture identity, or depth.
mechanism.generality: Eligibility derives only from immutable bytecode, parameter layout, the live identity of the function's self upvalue, and primitive argument values. It does not inspect benchmark names, source paths, function names, iteration counts, or workload values. The plan accepts only a complete side-effect-free number/control/call subset and falls back before observable work for all other functions.
semantic_risks: preserving Number arithmetic, comparisons, NaN, signed zero, and truthiness exactly for every admitted operation
requiring the captured recursive binding to retain the exact live function identity before bypassing ordinary Call semantics
preserving JavaScript argument order and missing-argument behavior while transferring a completed child result to its caller frame
never allowing a partial scalar execution to skip a mutable binding, coercion, exception, accessor, Proxy, eval, with, closure, generator, async, or constructor behavior
falling back to the original VM before a depth limit changes observable recursion behavior

profile_evidence.shared_cost: Of 816 main-thread samples, 713 are rooted in Vm::run_completion and recursively re-enter direct-leaf call setup. A direct bytecode inspection shows the hot ack, fib, and tak bodies consist only of primitive numeric constants and parameters, primitive comparisons/arithmetic, branches, returns, and fixed-arity self calls, so the unit removes the full VM, CallEnv, Value, and operand-vector path only after an all-or-nothing proof.
